title: Hydration vs Bathroom-Visit Balance
dataSources: Posture readings (`posture:reading`), symptom logs (`symptom:log`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), sneeze events (`sneeze:event`).
app: Everyday body-signal logs — posture sensors, symptom and allergy journals, hydration-linked bathroom logs, and quirky personal counters — sent to Splunk HEC via wearables, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=hydration:intake OR sourcetype=bathroom:visit)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(sourcetype=="hydration:intake",ml,0))) as ml_in, sum(eval(if(sourcetype=="bathroom:visit",1,0))) as visits by _time
| sort - _time
description: Compares how much you drank with how often you visited the bathroom, a light-hearted balance check.
value: Beyond the humour, an unusual mismatch over time can be a genuinely useful health signal to mention to a doctor.
implementation: Join hydration and bathroom logs in `index=personal`; trend intake against visits.
visualization: Dual-axis chart of water intake versus bathroom visits.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how much you drink with how often you visit the loo, a light-hearted balance check.
